title: Gradient-Free Approaches is a Key to an Efficient Interaction with Markovian Stochasticity
summary: This paper deals with stochastic optimization problems involving Markovian noise with a zero-order oracle. We present and analyze a novel derivative-free method for solving such problems in strongly convex smooth and non-smooth settings with both one-point and two-point feedback oracles. Using a randomized batching scheme, we show that when mixing time $τ$ of the underlying noise sequence is less than the dimension of the problem $d$, the convergence estimates of our method do not depend on $τ$.
